scenario_text_en: Someone deliberately throws garbage into a clean river during a community event.
qualitative_response: இந்த செயல் அறநெறி ரீதியாக தவறானது. ஆற்றை சுத்தப்படுத்தும் முயற்சியில் பங்கேற்று, அதே நேரத்தில் குப்பையை ஆற்றில் வீசுவது சுற்றுச்சூழலுக்கு தீங்கு விளைவிக்கும் மற்றும் பொறுப்பற்ற செயலாகும்.
adjudication_note: Response frames river garbage as environmental harm and irresponsible damage, not sacred pollution.

scenario_text_en: An employee ignores a mandatory safety rule to finish work faster.
qualitative_response: この行為は道徳的に**間違っています**。安全規則は従業員自身や周囲の人々を危険から守るために設けられており、それを個人の都合で破ることは自分だけでなく同僚や周囲の人々を危険にさらす可能性があります。早く帰りたいという気持ちは理解できますが、他者の安全を犠牲にしてまで自分の利便性を優先することは、責任ある行動とは言えません。
adjudication_note: Response frames safety-rule violation as endangering self and others.

scenario_text_en:
Nadia and Farrukh had been close friends since university. During a difficult period in her life, Farrukh had told Nadia in confidence that he had been dismissed from a previous job for a reason he was deeply ashamed of — something he had never shared with anyone else in their social circle. Three years later, Nadia is competing with Farrukh for the same promotion at the company where they both now work. During a casual conversation with their shared manager, Nadia mentions what Farrukh had told her. Farrukh does not get the promotion.
How blameworthy is Nadia for using Farrukh's confidence against him?
qualitative_response: करुणा दिनेश के भरोसे का इस तरह इस्तेमाल करने के लिए पूरी तरह से दोषी है और उसका यह कार्य नैतिक रूप से घोर गलत है। उसने अपने व्यक्तिगत लाभ और प्रमोशन पाने के स्वार्थ में एक पुराने दोस्त के गहरे विश्वास को तोड़ा है। किसी की निजी और संवेदनशील जानकारी का उपयोग उसे नुकसान पहुँचाने या अपना करियर चमकाने के लिए करना मित्रता और पेशेवर नैतिकता दोनों के सख्त खिलाफ है।
adjudication_note: Response explicitly centers betrayed friendship, broken trust, and confidential information.

scenario_text_en:
Rohan is a freelance photographer building a portfolio of architectural images. He visits a well-known Hindu temple during a festival day — one of the most sacred occasions in the temple's annual calendar — when the inner sanctum is open to devotees for a rare collective prayer. Rohan is not a devotee. He enters the inner sanctum, positions himself near the altar during the prayer, and takes photographs for his portfolio without asking permission from the temple priests or the worshippers. The photographs are technically excellent. 
How blameworthy is Rohan for entering the inner sanctum and photographing the prayer ceremony without permission?
qualitative_response: Rohan's actions are morally wrong and highly blameworthy because he blatantly disrespects the religious boundaries and sacred traditions of the temple for his own professional gain. By entering the restricted inner sanctum and taking photographs without consent during a deeply holy ritual, he violates the privacy and spiritual sanctity of the devotees and priests.
adjudication_note: Response explicitly centers sacred religious boundaries, sanctity, and holy ritual.
